title: Analysis of Triggered Packet Streams: A Matrix-Analytic Method for Exponential Triggering Delays
summary: In many communication networks, the transmission of a packet may automatically trigger the transmission of a subsequent packet from the same source after a (possibly random) delay, without requiring acknowledgment or feedback. Such behavior arises in multi-stage status updating, proactive protocols, and other applications where users generate causally dependent packet streams. In this paper, in order to analyze these systems, we introduce the $\mathrm{M^T/G/1}$ queue.
